verdict.line: You win by abusing the pre-6 all-in window and punishing every whiffed Death's Grasp; you lose if the lane drags past level 9-10 and Mordekaiser's Indestructible sustain plus his stat-stealing ultimate let him out-scale the trades he was losing.

brief.thesis: Kled's Joust-W-Joust combo (full E, then W, then the E dash-back) lands faster and hits harder than anything Mordekaiser can answer with before level 6, which is why both the lane and solo-kill edge sit with Kled in this data. That edge erodes once Mordekaiser's W (Indestructible) has enough banked damage to heal off trades and his R (Realm of Death) threatens to steal your stats on a kill — the 46.3% win rate over 108 games says this matchup is won early and defended late, not scaled into.

theirWindow.when: Right after Death's Grasp lands on you
theirWindow.what: You're pulled into Obliterate range while his passive (Darkness Rise) racks up its third proc for free damage and move speed — disengage with a remaining Joust charge the instant the pull ends rather than fighting it out.

yourWindow.when: Death's Grasp is down or just whiffed
yourWindow.what: Joust (E) in immediately, pop Violent Tendencies (W) for the four empowered autos, then re-cast E to dash back out before his Obliterate (8-4s cooldown) can land a second time.

start.why: 46.4% win rate over 110 games and 82.1% pick rate — the sustain and early AD keep you winning repeated dismount/remount skirmishes before Morde's shield comes online.

boots.why: 52.8% win rate over 72 games, 66.1% pick rate — Mordekaiser's entire kit (Obliterate, Death's Grasp, Realm of Death) is magic damage, so the magic resist directly blunts every trade.

core.why: Wave-clear and bonus HP scale your all-in combo and let you threaten a split-push the moment the lane stabilizes.
Armor shred stacks off your Joust dashes and W auto-attacks, pushing damage through before his Indestructible shield can bank enough to heal.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive damage and healing scale with the extended E-W-E trades this matchup is built around, and it keeps paying off even if a fight runs longer than planned against his Indestructible sustain.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the standard pick (76.8% pick rate) and converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills before he can sustain off Indestructible. Exhaust+Flash posts a 60% win rate in its smaller sample and directly cuts the healing he'd otherwise bank off that same shield during a drawn-out trade.

playing.title: Abuse the pre-6 all-in
playing.detail: Before Mordekaiser hits level 6, his only answers to an all-in are Obliterate (8-4s cooldown) and Death's Grasp (16-8s cooldown); chain Q (Bear Trap) into E (Jousting), fire W (Violent Tendencies), then E back before he can reset with another Q.

playing.title: Only dash in when his E is down
playing.detail: Track whether Death's Grasp has been cast or whiffed — its cooldown is your green light to Joust in without getting pulled into his Obliterate range.

playing.title: Watch for his third landed hit
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after Mordekaiser lands 3 attacks or spells on you, giving him a damage aura and move speed — don't commit your Joust dash-back into a trade where he's about to proc it.

playing.title: Front-load before his shield banks
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage he can later consume to heal, so land your full Q-E-W-E combo in one burst instead of poking, denying him time to bank shield value.

playing.title: Finish duels fast, don't poke
playing.detail: Obliterate deals more damage to a single target, so a drawn-out 1v1 lets his Q ramp and his passive aura tip the trade back his way — use your solo-kill advantage decisively, not slowly.

playing.title: Respect Realm of Death's cooldown
playing.detail: His ultimate is 140/125/110/110/110s and steals your stats on a kill — play safer around his ult timer once he hits level 6 rather than forcing all-ins blind.

playing.title: Split-push if the lane stalls
playing.detail: Past level 13, his sustain and stat-steal snowball start outscaling extended trades — use Titanic Hydra/Hullbreaker wave clear to pressure side lanes instead of forcing more 1v1s.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured from live Kled vs Mordekaiser games on the current patch (108-game head-to-head sample); the timing windows, trade sequencing, and power-curve reads are my own analysis of how the two kits interact.

stats.opponentTip: Try to use Jousting [E] and Violent Tendencies [W] to deal damage and retreat safely afterwards with Jousting [E]. Do not get pulled in by Mordekaiser’s Death’s Grasp (E).
